units.source_text: 因此，我根本無法一個人行走在東京街頭，無奈之下，只好整日窩在家裡度日。

en.t: Therefore, I simply could not walk the streets of Tokyo alone, so in desperation I spent whole days shut up at home.

units.source_text: 把錢包交給堀木一起逛街時，堀木很會討價還價，

en.t: When I handed my wallet to Horiki and went around town with him, Horiki was very good at bargaining,

units.source_text: 而且很懂得玩，能以最少的錢發揮出最大的效果。

en.t: and he knew how to enjoy himself, getting the greatest effect from the least money.

units.source_text: 他從來不坐昂貴的計程車，即使乘坐電車、公共汽車、小汽艇等等，

en.t: He never took expensive taxis; even when he used streetcars, buses, little launches, and the like,

units.source_text: 他也會分清路段，以最短的時間抵達目的地，施展他超人的手腕。

en.t: he sorted out each route and reached our destination in the shortest time, displaying his superhuman skill.

units.source_text: 早晨從妓院回家途中，他會順道拐到某家餐館泡熱水澡，

en.t: On mornings when he was going home from a brothel, he would stop by some restaurant on the way and take a hot bath,

units.source_text: 再點盤豆腐，喝幾杯小酒，價格便宜，卻感覺很奢華，

en.t: then order a dish of tofu and drink a few small cups of sake; it was cheap, but felt luxurious,

units.source_text: 以此對我實施現場教育。

en.t: using these things to give me practical lessons on the spot.
